column3: Bring 8 Dentrium Power Stones and 8 An'Alleum Power Stones to Rigglefuzz in the Badlands.
column4: A while ago, I had an incident with the Shadowforge Dwarves.  They brought me to Angor Fortress to study two types of strange stones from Uldaman.  I discovered that the stones were sustained, stable power sources if treated correctly.  It's amazing the things one can find in that old dig site!$B$BAnyway, after I told them the secret of the stones they kicked me out of Angor Fortress and began digging for more in Uldaman.$B$BI want those stones for myself!  Bring me both types and I'll pay you plenty!

column3: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in Stonetalon Mountains when you are ready.
column4: You have brought me the book, and now it is time for your question. Are you ready?$B$BTime is not an issue, $c, so do not feel pressured. You may take as long as you like to answer.Answer Braug Dimspirit's question correctly

column3: Bring the Tablet of Ryun'eh to Theldurin the Lost.
column4: Oh my!  Oh my!  There is a doom approaching.  Mark me!  A doom!$B$BNo, I cannot speak of it...cannot utter their names or they may hear me!  But if we learn, yes, if we learn more of them...then maybe we can learn how to foil them!$B$BMaybe.$B$BGo into Uldaman.  No!  I said it!  You must find...find the tablet of...Ryun'eh.  Yes, find it!  And don't make me speak that name again!$B$BIt is deep in that place, in an ancient chest.  That's where it hides...in a chest crafted before the works of any dwarf.

column3: Bring 6 Draenethyst crystals to Magtoor at The Harborage in the Swamp of Sorrows.
column4: The lost ones who live in the Fallow Sanctuary look as we look, but they are monsters... driven mad by the rigors of our journey to Azeroth.  Once our brethren, they now live in the Fallow Sanctuary to the east, catching or killing any who wander near.$B$BAnd they have stolen something sacred to us--draenethyst crystals.$B$BWe lack the force to enter the Fallow Sanctuary and reclaim our stolen draenethyst from among their huts and campfires, but without those crystals... we too may lose our way.

column3: Deliver the Twice Reordered Package to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
column4:
As much as I don't like the guy, I've heard what the Bloodscalp tribe do to their prisoners, and it ain't pretty. I'm glad Zimmix made it out alright.

However, I have another urgent delivery and I do NOT trust him to take it on. The problem? Nobody else will be available to take this before he does. You, however, have rescued lost cargo and a captured goblin, so you're looking pretty trustworthy from down here.

Any chance I can convince you to take this to Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port?

column3: Bring $1oa Briny Seafood Stew to Jasper Geartoggle in Powderfuse Port.
column4:
Folks keep dumpin' their furry friends here like I know what I'm doin'. And then they blame me if they come back and their horse or wolf or... whatever they brought is dead or ran off. What do I look like, I'm runnin' a charity?

You look like you know your way around a trough. Mind whippin' me up some grub I can use to keep these beasties in check?

If you can't make it yourself, someone might be willin' to sell you some. And hurry! Last thing I need is a stampede of hungry animals.

column3: Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Virulent Blood of Agamaggan, then return it to Kog'thug the Brave at Bristleback Retreat in the Desolace. Kog'thug felt it worth reminding that the Blood of Agamaggan inside Razorfen Kraul would not be sufficient.
column4:
Big $R heard of Razorfen Downs? <Snort.> Of course not! Big place in Barrens. Lots of thorns. Can't miss it.

Agamaggan died there. Important place for all quilboar. Now bristleback not allowed. Belong to sniffle-snorting Razorfen. Razorfen disrespect quilboar history!

Agamaggan's blood feeds the valley. Grow thorns. BIG ones. Bigger than puny elf necklace ever could!

Go to the Downs. Fetch Kog'thug blood. Stale blood from the kraul won't work. Need GOOD blood!

Give blood, get necklace, win.

column3: Bring Gan'zulah's Head and Nezzliok's Head to the bubbling cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
column4: Yenniku was not among the heads, and I thank the Great Serpent for it.  But we are no closer to finding him.$B$BWe must know the truth, and I fear that only the Bloodscalp chief and his witchdoctor know it.  They are the enemies of the Darkspear tribe and will not speak freely, so we must force the truth from their dead lips!$B$BBring me the heads of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok the Dire and place them within this cauldron.$B$BThey are deep within Zul'Kunda.  Bring their heads...we will then make them talk.

column3: Kill Prince Galen Trollbane and bring the Sigil of Trollbane to Zengu in Hammerfall.
column4: The final of the sigils needed to unlock the tomb of Thoras Trollbane is held by his son personally. He resides deep within Stromgarde, in a chapel in the militia-held districts. Prince Galen is well protected and no slouch of a warrior himself, so this task could prove most difficult.

column3: Find the missing courier, and ensure Dar's shipment is delivered to the Harborage.
column4:
The draenei of the Harborage are skilled fishermen, and willing to trawl more dangerous waters than I. We occasionally trade. They give us some of their catch, and I offer some of our extra supplies.

I'd sent a goblin courier to deliver my latest shipment, but he never returned. A crocolisk likely made a meal of him.

More importantly, my business reputation is at stake. That shipment must be found, and delivered to the harborage. Please, find it if you can. Check near the waters along the road.
